description: Prop firm plans that cost least to reach a funded account, one plan per firm, from each firm's own pages. Filter by market, account size, country (firms whose own list names it are left out), news-trading rule, platform, budget, drawdown type, max steps, no consistency rule, no time limit, max activation fee and on-chain payout proof. Prices are without any promo code; cost_to_funded_usd is price plus any activation fee (our sum). Each result links the firm's facts page to cite.

account_size.description: Account size in USD, for example 50000 or 100000.

country.description: Where the trader lives: a two-letter code ("GB") or a country name. Firms whose own list names it are left out.

drawdown_type.description: Keep only plans whose stated drawdown matches "static", "eod" (end-of-day) or "trailing".

has_onchain_payout_proof.description: When true, keep only firms with tracked on-chain stablecoin payouts in TradingLookup's payout records.

max_activation_fee_usd.description: Keep only plans with a stated activation fee at or below this USD amount (use 0 for no activation fee).

max_cost_usd.description: Most the trader wants to pay to reach funded.

max_steps.description: Keep only plans with at most 1 or 2 evaluation steps (instant funding counts as 0 steps).

news_trading.description: "allowed": the firm says news trading is allowed; "allowed_or_limits": also firms that allow it with limits.

no_consistency_rule.description: When true, keep only firms whose own pages state no consistency rule.

no_time_limit.description: When true, keep only firms whose own pages state no time limit to pass.

platform.description: Text the firm's platform list must contain, for example "NinjaTrader" or "MT5".

name: find_prop_firms
title: Find prop firm plans by cost
